dailyPrecisionDiagnostics.note: Secondary observational diagnostics, NOT a reconstruction of the primary daily inputs and NOT unique proof of provider model/rounding implementation.

observedQuantization.interpretation: Returned-value lattice and bounded differences are consistent with separate product quantization/aggregation. They do not prove common model runs or uniquely identify provider internals.
